parts.when: [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.
parts.target: A **DRUKHARI** or **HARLEQUINS** unit of yours that is a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.
parts.effect: Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed** during the rest of the phase, if it has not fought yet this phase, roll a D6, with +1 to the roll if the unit's side is losing the [wager](vsdata:ability/drukhari.reapers-wager.callous-competition) at that point. data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

**Target:** A **DRUKHARI** or **HARLEQUINS** unit of yours that is a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed** during the rest of the phase, if it has not fought yet this phase, roll a D6, with +1 to the roll if the unit's side is losing the [wager](vsdata:ability/drukhari.reapers-wager.callous-competition) at that point. On a 4+, the model stays on the battlefield: once the attacking unit finishes its attacks, it can fight, and is then removed.
